mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, skies are clear near the Verona Public Library under a Waning Crescent moon. The temperature is 67 degrees, and we are expecting an overnight low of 48 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous vote by the Common Council to guide future development. Additionally, the city maintains its strong Moody's Aa1 rating.
There is plenty happening around town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Later this evening, you can check out ART House 360 or join the trivia competition at Hop Haus Brewing Company.
In a report covering September 28 to October 5, police responded to a motor vehicle crash on September 28 involving a 16-year-old operating an eMoto in a reckless manner.
Stop by Culver's of Verona today to enjoy the delicious Double Strawberry flavor of the day before they close at 10:00 PM.
